tools.name: search_offers
tools.description: Search AgentShopping offers. Optional filters cover typed product attrs (eu_size, size_cm, age_months, head_cm, total_nok_max, and the rest of the schema). q also parses phrases such as 'str 33', 'til 3-åring', 'under 5000 kr' and '52 cm hode'. If sample_data is true, prices are fictional. Ranking n

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Fetch one product by slug, gtin or id, with ranked offers, coupons, price history and JSON-LD. Sample rows are labelled sample=true.

tools.name: list_merchants
tools.description: List stores in the merchant directory: categories they sell, markets, currencies, price band, coupons, affiliate network, and /go/ shop links. sample=true means the store is seeded example data, not a live feed.

tools.name: find_stores_for
tools.description: Find which stores sell a category, optionally in one country. Returns price bands, coupons, networks and tracked_url shop links via /go/. Sample rows must not be cited as live prices.

tools.name: list_coupons
tools.description: List coupons with valid_from and valid_until. Expired codes are omitted unless include_expired is true. Sample codes are labelled.
